title: HIFI: A Highly Efficient Framework for Statistical Inference with Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.34550v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Foundation models provide powerful representations for unstructured data, such as text and images, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) makes their adaptation to downstream tasks increasingly practical. For neural estimators that lack a tractable sampling distribution, resampling-based procedures offer a flexible route to statistical inference, but they often require hundreds of model fits, making them computationally prohibitive at foundation-model scale. We introduce HIFI, a two-stage fine-tuning framework for statistical inference on parameters such as conditional means. Stage 1 adapts a foundation model once on a larger sample, capturing the complex structure of the data and controlling estimation bias through a single fit. translated_title: HIFI：一个基于基础模型的高效统计推断框架
translated_abstract: 基础模型为文本和图像等非结构化数据提供了强大的表示能力，而参数高效微调（PEFT）使基础模型向下游任务的适配日益可行。对于缺乏可解析采样分布的神经估计器，基于重采样的方法为统计推断提供了灵活的途径，但这类方法通常需要对模型进行数百次拟合，在基础模型规模下计算上难以承受。我们提出了HIFI，一个用于对条件均值等参数进行统计推断的两阶段微调框架。第一阶段在较大的样本上对基础模型进行一次适配，捕捉数据的复杂结构并通过单次拟合控制估计偏差。第二阶段在较小的独立样本上应用重采样推断程序，同时拟合多个轻量级PEFT估计器来拟合残差，从而无需重新学习即可量化估计的不确定性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HIFI提出一种两阶段微调框架：第一阶段在大样本上仅对基础模型做一次微调以捕捉数据结构并控制估计偏差，第二阶段在小样本上并行拟合多个轻量级PEFT估计器并结合重采样进行统计推断，从而把原本需要数百次模型拟合的高昂计算开销降至可承受水平。
en_tdlr: HIFI is a two-stage fine-tuning framework that enables efficient statistical inference with foundation models by fitting the model only once on a large sample and then applying resampling with lightweight PEFT estimators on a small sample, avoiding the prohibitive cost of hundreds of model refits.
